content: Kulombana muyegha jha Kilichitu
Ne hele nakibha napungwa kwa nhwalo jha kunhenge Bhambo, nimpembekeya ntame ngita chinkemitwe na Chapanga ntame.
Machiko ghoha mmangana mabhando bha unyenyekeho na utokomalo na luhimba, nhimbililane mabhene kwa mabhene kwa upalano.
Nghagha kujhendele kukamwu kulombana kwino kukuletwa na Uhuke gwa Chapanga kupete uteeke ghughumeka pamonga.
Ibhii yegha jhimo jha Kilichitu na Uhuke gwa nyahinyahi ghumo, ngita chilibhii lihobholelo limo lyankemii Chapanga chilibhii limo.
Abhii Bhambo jhumo na kihobholelo chimo na ubaticho ghumo.
Abhii Chapanga jhumo jwabhii Tate jwa bhoha, jwenio ndi Bhambo jwa bhoha na ihenga lihengo kupete bhoha na abhii mu ghoha.
Nambo kila mundo apokii hupo ngita Kilichitu champekii.
Ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga,
Bho, puilonge, “Ijhenda kunane kwa Chapanga,” mana jhake nike? Mana jhake hote akatumbwii kuhika pahe hake jha nnema.
Yene jhojho ndi jwahulwika pannema pano na jhojho ngajhawila kunane kwa Chapanga hake ahutweleye nnema ghoha.

Jwenio jwabhatehila bhando bhange bhabhe akatenga na bhange milondole bha Chapanga na bhange kubhehe akatangacha Malobhe gha Chapanga na bhange bhibhalongocha bhando bha Chapanga na bhange bhabhe akabhola.
Atehila naha kupala kulenganikii bhando bha Chapanga kwa lihengo lya kunhenge Kilichitu lya kuichenga yegha jhake.
Yene twe twabhoha tulombikane tubhehe kilebhe chimo mukihobholelo na kummanya Mwana gwa Chapanga, tubhehe bhando bhitukomile mukihobholelo nakuhikii ukangamalo ngita gwa Kilichitu jwenio.
Yene tubhejhe kabhele ngita yana ichokombe, bhibhahoto kukangwa kongo na kongo na kujhembeluwa na kila upepo gwa mabholo gha bhando bha uwange kupala kuhobhecha bhando.
Anda tulongii uchakaka kwa upalo, natukola ade kunhikii Kilichitu jwabhii muto.

Mulongoche gwake, ihungo yoha ya yegha ikamulana nde kwa ncheketa, na yegha jhoha ukamulichwa nde kwa kutangatilwa ihungo yake. Yene, kila kihungo anda kihenga lihengo lyake maha, yegha jhoha ukola na kukichenga mulipalano.
Ughome nhyono kwa kulombana na Kilichitu
Ngohe kwa liina lya Bhambo, ninkelebhuwa mangajhendele kabhele ngita bhando bhangaumanya Chapanga, bhibhawacha ghachawana,
na malango ghabhe ghabhii mulubhendo tyoo. Bhabhii kutale na ughome gwa Chapanga nhwalo gwa undindilima ghubhii nkate jhabhe na mitaho jhabhe.
Bhando bheniya bhakwetejhe hone, na bhakijhingii mu ilebhe yanganandela na bhipala kuhenga ilebhe ya hone na kupala kubhehe na ilebhe mbwe hake.
Nambo mangota mwe mukamanyitejhe kwa namuna Kilichitu yenio.
Ndi mukaumanye uchakaka malobhe gha Yecho, mukibha bhabholwa bhake ndi ngamolitwa chakaka jhibhii nkate jhake.
Mmolitwe muuleke ghola ghanganandela ghuteila makacho, ngita mundo chaula ngobho yake, nhwalo itendwa hino ya makacho inongwicha mukomelekeho kwa tama hino ikopokiya.
Miojho jhino na malango ghino ghaghalambuke na ghabhehe mahyono.
Uhwale umundo nhyono ghupanginwe kwa kulandana na Chapanga, ntame mughome ghujheketelwa palonge jha Chapanga na unyahinyahi gwa chakaka.
Kwa gheniya, muleka uwange. Kila mundo ipalwa kunnobholela nnyake uchakaka, nhwalo twenga twabhoha ndi kihungo cha yegha jha Kilichitu.
Anda nchimwite, mangajheketela jhe lilaka lino linongoche kuhenga uhakaho, hilu nkoto kubhehe na lilaka ade lyobha litipike tipi,
kupala mangampe jhe Limbembela pwache.
Jwakibha ajhibhita, akoto kujhibha kabhele, nambo ahenge lihengo lyambone kwa mabhoko ghake, ankola na kilebhe cha kuntangatii mundo jwanga kilebhe.
Malobhe gha uwenje ghakoto kupita munnomo gwino, nambo nnongele malobhe ghambone ghatangatile kwachenga bhando bhibhannyokanikiya.
Nkoto kuneke uchongo Uhuke gwa Chapanga jwa nyahinyahi, nhwalo jwenio ndi unepo gwa Chapanga kwino kubhehe mangota ndi bhando bhake, nhwalo ilangii kubhehe lichiko lya kunkombola lihika kwino.
Ngohe nkoto kubhehe na uchongo amu nkoto kubhehe na lilaka na nkoto kuyoma na njobhelo na maligho. Muleke gwanganandela ghoghoha!
Nambo mme na mwojho gwambone na kukolelana kiya, kila mundo annekekeya malemo nnyake ngita Chapanga chanekekiye uhakaho mangota kwa ndela jha Kilichitu.
